# archestra_team_vault_folder (Resource)

Maps an Archestra team to an external HashiCorp Vault folder path; the team can only read secrets under that path. Enterprise Edition only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Map a team to an external HashiCorp Vault folder path. The team can
# only read secrets under that path. Enterprise Edition only.
#
# Each team can have at most one folder, so this resource is a
# per-team singleton; changing `team_id` forces replacement.

resource "archestra_team_vault_folder" "engineering" {
  team_id    = archestra_team.engineering.id
  vault_path = "secret/data/engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) ID of the team this folder grants access to. Each team can have at most one folder; changing this forces a new resource.
- `vault_path` (String) Vault KV path the team can read from (e.g. `secret/data/engineering`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Vault folder mapping identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by team ID — each team has at most one vault folder, so the
# team ID uniquely identifies the mapping.
terraform import archestra_team_vault_folder.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
